exposure: prophylactic endovascular internal iliac balloon catheter use
Use of prophylactic endovascular internal iliac balloon catheters
outcome: Packed red blood cell transfusion requirement
cohort: 30 pregnant women with placenta accreta spectrum undergoing scheduled delivery
finding: Prophylactic endovascular internal iliac balloon catheter use during surgery for placenta accreta spectrum was not associated with decreased blood loss, transfusion, or complications, but was associated with increased anesthesia, operating room, and surgical time.
mod_finding: The use of prophylactic endovascular internal iliac balloon catheters was not associated with decreased blood loss, packed red blood cell transfusion, or surgical complications in women undergoing surgical management for placenta accreta spectrum.
